# Agent

An agent as data: one `loom.agent/1` document naming the agent and its brief, its models, the harness session it may run (kind, run budget, stop policy, confinement and tool policy), its outer and inner loop, the states an item is projected by, the bindings it reads and writes through, its channel, write policy, capabilities, exposure, runtime and deployment.

`loom.agent` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

`loom.agent.A2aCard` is a record of three fields:

- `name` — `String`
- `description` — `String`
- `skills` — `List<String>`

`loom.agent.A2aExposure` is a record of three fields:

### `Binding`

`loom.agent.Binding` is one of two shapes, told apart by a `kind` field — tagged, so a decoder never has to guess which branch it is reading:

- `connectors` — `loom.agent.ConnectorsBinding`
- `http` — `loom.agent.HttpBinding`

### `CheckAgentSpec`

`loom.agent.CheckAgentSpec`.

It takes:

- `path` — `String`

It has nine outcomes.

**`malformed`** — Decided outside the input: the document at the path does not decode as a loom.agent/1 document. No predicate over the input reaches this branch, and saying `when: false` instead would have claimed it is unreachable, which is a different and false statement. No entity in this specification changes. It reports `loom.agent.SpecRefused`, carrying `reason`, `member` and `detail`. It emits nothing. A test reaches it by injecting the declared fault, because no input can.

## Errors

### `SpecRefused`

It carries:

- `reason` — `loom.agent.RefusalReason`
- `member` — `String`
- `detail` — `String`

Reported by `loom.agent.CheckAgentSpec` on its `malformed`, `secret-literal`, `unknown-protocol`, `unknown-action`, `unbound-source`, `http-method`, `send-without-writes` and `empty-channel-allow` outcomes.
